title: OS User Preference Media Query Sandbox
description: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-color-scheme, and forced-colors in real CSS tokens to inspect animation and contrast fallbacks.
html:
Notification Banner

Buttons that rely only on background fills disappear under Windows Forced Colors unless a transparent border is declared.
js: var root = document.getElementById('sandbox-root'); var tag = document.getElementById('mode-tag'); if (root && tag) { var flags = []; if (root.classList.contains('pref-reduce-motion')) flags.push('reduce-motion'); if (root.classList.contains('pref-forced-colors')) flags.push('forced-colors'); flags.push(root.classList.contains('scheme-light') ? 'light' : 'dark'); tag.textContent = flags.join(' | '); }
expectedObservation: Enabling prefers-reduced-motion stops the pulsing dot animation immediately. Enabling forced-colors strips background fills so the border: none button loses its visible boundary while border: 1px solid transparent stays outlined.
